channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold steadies after sliding to fresh seven-month low, Fed rate-hike bets weigh
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) rebounds on Tuesday after falling to a fresh seven-month low of $3,941 in the Asian session, as dip buyers help the precious metal recover some of its losses. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,028.

item.title: Euro: Fiscal strength and reserve status – BNP Paribas
item.description: BNP Paribas strategists highlight that despite weaker post-Covid productivity than the United States (US), the European Union retains stronger public finances and growing international use of the Euro (EUR).

item.title: Euro underperforms amid doubts over further ECB rate hikes through year-end
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is down against its major currency peers, trading 0.17% lower to near 1.1400 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: JOLTS Job Openings set to decline slightly in May as Fed focuses on taming inflation
item.description: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) for May on Tuesday at 14:00 GMT.

item.title: Indian Rupee remains supported against US Dollar due to lower Oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades subduedly against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday.

item.title: Euro trims gains against British Pound despite positive Eurozone PMI figures
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades lower against the British Pound (GBP) for the second consecutive day on Tuesday, with price action approaching 11-month lows at 0.8600.

item.title: WTI Oil steadies around $70.00 as markets bet on a negotiated end to Iran’s conflict
item.description: Crude Oil prices remain flat for the second consecutive day this week, with the price of the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) barrel stuck at the $70.00 area.

item.title: Silver rebounds as Fed rate hike expectations cap gains before US labor data
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) rebounds on Tuesday and trades around $58.80, up 0.96% at the time of writing, after finding support near $56.60 earlier in the day.

item.title: Danish Krone: Nationalbanken tolerance for weaker krone – Nordea
item.description: Nordea strategists examine EUR/DKK trading at its weakest level since the Euro’s introduction and argues Nationalbanken may have quietly shifted its de facto intervention band.

item.title: Brazilian Real: Rising rates signal currency risk – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank FX analyst Michael Pfister examines why higher Brazilian interest rate expectations tend to weaken the Brazilian Real (BRL) rather than support it.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $58.58 per troy ounce, up 0.54% from the $58.27 it cost on Monday.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling seen grinding lower against Euro – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley discusses British Pound (GBP) performance around United Kingdom (UK) political developments, focusing on potential leadership by Burnham and adherence to existing fiscal rules.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar advances as ANZ outlook jumps
item.description: NZD/USD gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 0.5650 during the European hours on Tuesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) maintains its upward momentum, drawing strong support from a sharp rebound in domestic sentiment.

item.title: Oil: Upside risks linger as recovery questioned – ING
item.description: ING strategists Michiel Tukker and Benjamin Schroeder note that Oil has returned to pre-war levels but argue the market is overly optimistic about the speed and durability of the supply recovery.

item.title: Japanese Yen hangs near four-decade low vs USD as carry trade counters intervention risks
item.description: The USD/JPY pair sticks to a bullish bias for the second consecutive day and trades around the 162.30 region during the first half of the European session, near a four-decade high touched earlier this Tuesday.

item.title: Gold: Deeper pullback eyes October lows – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists note that Gold has extended its decline after breaking the 50-day moving average in March and is drifting toward the late October 2025 lows. While the move looks stretched, they see no clear rebound signals yet.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Snaps three-day losing streak amid caution ahead of US NFP data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) rebounds after a three-day losing streak, with the US Dollar Index (DXY) trading 0.3% higher to near 101.40.

item.title: Canada: Growth drag and steady BoC – NBC
item.description: National Bank of Canada's (NBC) Taylor Schleich and Vy Le highlight that Canada’s 2026 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) forecast has been cut to 0.7%, leaving the economy lagging U.S. growth above 2%.

item.title: Why is the Japanese Yen at 40-year lows when Japan’s economy is growing?
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) has decisively breached long-standing four-decade technical resistance, climbing past 162.00 to reach values not seen since 1986.

item.title: British Pound holds below 1.3250 after a downward revision of UK GDP
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is giving away previous gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, weighed by the downward revision of the UK’s Q1 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data.

item.title: Canadian Dollar slips as Fed hawkish stance lifts US Dollar
item.description: USD/CAD remains stronger for the second successive day, hovering around 1.4230 during the European session on Tuesday. The currency pair steadies as the US Dollar (USD) strengthens on growing expectations of a hawkish Federal Reserve interest rate path.

item.title: Gold flat lines below $4,050 as Fed hike bets and firmer USD cap recovery from YTD low
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to build on its intraday recovery from the lowest level since November 2025, touched earlier this Tuesday, and trades below $4,050, nearly unchanged during the first half of the European session.

item.title: India: Capital flows supported by RBI and government – DBS
item.description: DBS economist Radhika Rao details India’s capital account challenges, citing weakening capital flows, softer foreign portfolio inflows and narrower net Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) that pushed the balance of payments into deficit in FY26.

item.title: BoJ’s Sato: De-escalation of Middle East conflict is welcome move, uncertainty remains
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister (PM) Sanae Takaichi's administration newly appointed Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member, Ayano Sato, said in his scheduled press conference during the European trading session on Tuesday that the de-escalation of the Middle East conflict is welcome news for the economy, but unc

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Poised to extend gains beyond 0.8100 amid broadly firmer USD
item.description: The USD/CHF pair sticks to its modest intraday gains through the first half of the European session on Tuesday, with bulls now awaiting a sustained strength above the 0.8100 mark before placing fresh bets.

item.title: United Kingdom: Devolution vision and economic trade-offs – Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered Bank’s Chief Economist for Europe and UK, Christopher Graham, reviews Andy Burnham’s plan to make devolution a central pillar of his premiership.

item.title: Dow Jones futures gain on potential US-Iran talks, tech rally
item.description: The Dow Jones futures rise 0.08% to trade near 52,610, while S&P 500 futures gain 0.10%, trading near 7,510. Tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 futures led the upward move, rising 0.20% to trade near 30,110 during European trading hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risks rise with Fed hawkishness – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that USD/JPY has broken above its July 2024 high as the US Dollar strengthens on a hawkish Federal Reserve backdrop.

item.title: Euro: Sintra seen validating hike expectations – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole writes that European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde’s opening remarks in Sintra were measured and do not signal a radical shift in policy communication.

item.title: ECB’s Sleijpen: Energy price retreat will have an impact on inflation
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker and Dutch central bank chief Olaf Sleijpen said in the European trade on Tuesday that the falling energy prices after easing Middle East tensions would cool down Eurozone inflationary pressures.
